title: Center-of-Mass Interpretation of Evolution Strategies
abstract: arXiv:2610.35865v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Evolution strategies (ES) update a model by sampling a population of perturbed copies, scoring each one, and moving in the reward-weighted direction of the perturbations. This update is usually presented as an estimate of a smoothed gradient. We present a geometrical interpretation of this update instead. Treat each perturbed model as a particle and its reward as the particle's mass. Before scoring, every particle has the same mass and the population balances at its centroid. Once rewards are assigned, it balances at its reward-weighted center of mass instead. We show that the mean-subtracted ES update is exactly this displacement, scaled by a scalar factor that depends on the mean reward, for any finite population. The physical reading needs nonnegative rewards, which can always be arranged by adding a constant to every reward without changing the update. In the limit of a large population or under antithetic sampling, the centroid sits

translated_abstract: 进化策略（ES）通过采样一群扰动副本、对每个副本进行评分，然后沿着扰动的奖励加权方向移动来更新模型。这种更新通常被表述为平滑梯度的估计。我们则提出了对这种更新的一种几何解释：将每个扰动模型视为一个粒子，其奖励视为粒子的质量。在评分之前，每个粒子质量相同，整个群体在其质心处平衡；一旦分配了奖励，群体便在其奖励加权的质心处平衡。我们证明，对于任意有限种群，减去均值的ES更新恰好就是这个位移，再乘以一个取决于平均奖励的标量因子。这一物理解读要求奖励非负，而这总是可以通过给每个奖励加上一个常数来实现，且不改变更新本身。在大种群极限或在对偶（antithetic）采样下，质心……
tldr: 本文提出进化策略更新的几何解释：将扰动模型视为粒子、奖励视为质量，证明减去均值的ES更新恰好等于种群从等质量质心到奖励加权质心的位移乘以一个标量因子。
en_tdlr: This paper offers a geometric interpretation of evolution strategies: treating perturbed models as particles and rewards as masses, it proves that the mean-subtracted ES update exactly equals the population's displacement from its uniform centroid to its reward-weighted center of mass, scaled by a scalar factor.
